entries.reason: iOS 6 does not export the name; it is carried with the text of the newer release
entries.effect: the constant is the string MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeTransit
entries.source: AVFoundation, AVFAudio, CoreImage, CoreText, MobileCoreServices and MapKit of the arm64 shared cache of iOS 12.0, where each constant is a string whose text was read; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3 and the iOS 6.0 emulator, asked with dlsym, which export none of the names
